Install#

Sourdough is one PHP command, so it works on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Requirements#

  • PHP 8.3 or newer (^8.3 in composer.json).
  • Composer, for the install lines below.
  • No PHP extensions are declared in composer.json.

Where the code lives: the canonical repository is enterprise-apps/sourdough on git.wayne.edu. Open issues and merge requests there; tags are made there, by the maintainer, with an approver. GitHub (waynestate/sourdough) is a read-only push mirror of it: nobody pushes to it, and Packagist reads from it. git.wayne.edu is the starter culture now; GitHub is the slice Packagist eats.

Install#

Two ways in: install the sourdough command on your machine, or scaffold without installing.

composer global require

composer global require waynestate/sourdough

composer create-project

composer create-project waynestate/sourdough

Note

After composer global require, the sourdough command lives in composer global config bin-dir --absolute; put that directory on your PATH.

Verify#

sourdough --version

Expected:

Sourdough 0.1.7

The CLI is a Symfony Console application named Sourdough, version 0.1.7 (bin/sourdough), so --version prints the name and the version.
